de1.P4.C4.ghi_chu: Anh cho: gia goc 30 trieu/nam (image12), 120 gian (image13), giam 1 trieu tang 20 gian (image4, image14), loi nhuan 245 trieu (image17), phi duy tri 2 trieu/gian (image18). Theo anh, so gian = 120 + 20(30 - x) = 720 - 20x nen doanh thu R(x) = x(720 - 20x), khong co trong cac phuong an; phuong an C va loi giai dung bo so khac (20 trieu / 100 gian / giam 2 trieu, loi nhuan 1950). Y b voi so anh cung khong cho nghiem dep. Can thay doi chieu de goc.
